clientLoader.scope: Source-proven candidate script URLs and guarded derivations only; no observed requests, execution, or successful loads.
clientLoader.byteConvention: Zero-based UTF-8 body byte offsets, end exclusive; literal evidence includes quotes. Hashes cover exactly those bytes.

derivation.baseRule: configured domain literal plus configured directory; both captured directories are empty
derivation.scriptRule: selectedBase + pathname (string concatenation, not document-relative resolution)

guards.invocation: Exported helper must be available/callable and a new singleton must be constructed.
guards.freshDetection: Without a recognized cached domain, the first successful configured-origin image probe selects the base; all-failure/falsy detection falls back to initial.
guards.cachedDomain: Cached domain is restricted to configured literals. The recognized-cookie branch probes but does not call the script loader in this helper; whether this branch was taken is unknown.
guards.initialUrl: Constructed if fresh detection chooses the initial base, returns no successful base, or the detection-chain catch invokes the initial loader.
guards.backupUrl: Constructed if fresh detection selects the configured backup and applyDetectedDomain reaches the script loader.
guards.assetInclusion: All five entries are unconditional in the supplied array; no per-asset feature guard appears here.
guards.ordering: All five share one selected base. Each script is appended with async=false only after the previous script completion promise resolves.
guards.failure: A script rejection stops later entries in that chain. applyDetectedDomain discards the load promise; asynchronous script failure does not trigger the detection catch or automatic CDN retry.
guards.laterReselection: The exposed reselection helper changes currentDomain/cache but does not call the script loader or resetParams.
